benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: AU Prathama Credit Card is an entry-level card designed for spenders looking to earn rewards on their everyday purchases. The card stands out primarily due to its very low annual fee of Rs. 100 , along with benefits on day-to-day spends. The card comes with a base reward rate of 1 point per Rs. 100 spent. However, consumers can earn 2X reward points on incremental spends above Rs. 5,000 in a month, along with contactless payments. Cardholders can redeem the accumulated reward points at a value of Rs. 0.25 per point. Apart from the rewards program, the card also offers other basic perks, such as a fuel surcharge waiver and 500 bonus reward points on the setup of a standing instruction or recurring transaction. Here is all you need to know about the AU Prathama Credit Card.

faqs.q: Does the card offer any welcome benefits or cashback?
faqs.a: No. AU Prathama Credit Card does not offer any welcome benefit upon joining, and there is no cashback on any spend category.

faqs.q: I am a beginner, can I apply for AU Prathama Credit Card?
faqs.a: Yes, this card is an entry-level credit card and is well-suited for first-time credit card users.

faqs.q: How can I get annual fee waived on the AU Prathama Credit Card?
faqs.a: If your total spends cross Rs. 75,000 in a year , the annual fee of Rs. 100 + GST will be waived off automatically.

faqs.q: What is the value of 1 reward point on the AU Prathama Credit Card?
faqs.a: Each reward point on the card is worth Rs.0.25 which means 100 reward points = Rs. 25.

faqs.q: What are the insurance benefits on offered with the AU Prathama Credit Card?
faqs.a: The card comes offers card liability cover, credit shield, and device protection plan.
